headline: Ghana Projected to Overtake Ethiopia as Africa's Eighth-Largest Economy
summary: Ghana's gross domestic product is forecast to reach $128.64 billion according to IMF data, allowing it to surpass Ethiopia as Africa's eighth-largest economy.
why: Sovereign economic ranking shifts reflect broader macroeconomic growth trends, foreign direct investment inflows, and changing regional economic influence across developing markets.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Higher projected GDP growth enhances the country's economic standing and attractiveness to foreign investors.
